geopolitics_summary: Russia sanctions deadline Wednesday; Iran oil reimposed; Middle East conflict risk; France nuclear constraints from heat; Ukraine pressuring Russia pre-winter.

themes.headline: EU sanctions package deadline Wednesday; oil price cap at risk
themes.why_it_matters: Oil price cap failure lifts Urals crude, raising EU gas demand via fuel-switch economics and Russian export revenue. TTF tension if Kremlin redirects supply eastward.

themes.headline: France nuclear reactors shut by extreme heat amid rising electricity demand
themes.why_it_matters: Nuclear outages reduce baseload, forcing peak-load gas dispatch. DA spreads widen; summer Cal+1 gas tightens. Heat-driven AC demand pushes power prices sharply higher.

themes.headline: Trump reimpose Iran oil sanctions; Strait of Hormuz 20% toll proposed
themes.why_it_matters: Iran sanctions + Hormuz disruption risk curtails global LNG supply. Higher LNG prices reduce arbitrage to Europe, lifting TTF. Middle East conflict escalates supply-route premium.

themes.headline: Russia halts diesel exports; Ukraine strikes refinery capacity
themes.why_it_matters: Refinery curtailment reduces Russian crude processing. If Russia imports fuel to cover domestic shortfall, export volumes drop—affects Urals flows, indirectly constrains EU diesel and naphtha feedstock.

themes.headline: Italy, Sweden contest EU green rules weakening in €2 trillion budget
themes.why_it_matters: Weakening green criteria could slow renewable investment, reducing renewables supply and raising EUA scarcity premium. Policy uncertainty depresses near-term EUA liquidity; awaiting resolution.

watchlist: EU sanctions package locked by Wednesday; oil price cap enforcement signal.
France nuclear availability update as heat wave persists; contingency demand on gas.
Iran oil reimposition enforcement; LNG arbitrage compression risk to TTF.
Ukraine winter leverage campaign; Russian fuel infrastructure damage trajectory.
